high_level_description: The image shows a screenshot of a mobile device interface, specifically a print settings screen. The top of the screen displays the time as 7:00 and various status icons such as Bluetooth, LTE connectivity, and battery level at 36%. Below these icons, there is a section titled "Select a printer," which includes several options for configuring a print job. The print settings include: Copies: Set to 1. Paper size: Set to Letter. Color: Set to Color. Orientation: Set to Portrait. Two-sided: Set to None. Pages: Set
